name: llard
source: Wang et al., 2025 (LLaRD); github.com/shuyao-wang/LLaRD @ 936fe15 (LLaRD.py, load_dataset.py, run_LLaRD.py); LLM knowledge rebuilt from the kit's training files by rq1kit.llard_knowledge
grid_source: The repository fixes alpha 0.1, beta 5.0, lr 1e-3, sigma 0.25, prf_weight 0.01, kd_temperature 0.2, edge_bias 0.5 and states no search ranges. 8-trial budget: lr_mult {0.2, 1} (the kit passes the plain model's tuned learning rate; the authors' is 1e-3) x alpha {0.1, 0.5} x beta {1, 5}; everything else at the authors' values; our choice. ML-1M only: the LLM knowledge is built for the kit's ML-1M splits (natural data and each injected-noise seed) and needs data/ml1m/llard on the machine that runs it.
memory: Three LightGCN propagations per batch (original, denoised, knowledge graph) on ML-1M (about 10k nodes) and one gate per edge; expected 3 to 5 times the time of Plain-BPR; needs <data>/llard/<build> with the profile embeddings and the LLM knowledge (copy from the machine that built it)
